note: Restoration Druid boss-specific lines were written by applying the general principles of Wowhead's rotation and Mythic+ tips and Icy Veins' Mythic+ tips to each mechanic (Rejuvenation and Wild Growth before big damage, Tranquility and Convoke the Spirits for dangerous windows, Ironbark for tank busters), because no dungeon-specific Restoration guides exist yet (Wowhead per-dungeon tips: "Check back after the season goes live"). Dispel types were checked against in-game tooltips.

i: tip
Thriving Growth: Wild Growth, Regrowth and Efflorescence healing has a chance to bloom Symbiotic Blooms (6 sec heal) on the target. Using Swiftmend or Wild Growth plants one guaranteed via Implant
aoe

When Symbiotic Blooms expire or you cast Rejuvenation on that target, Bursting Growth heals the target and up to 3 nearby allies. With Vigorous Creepers, targets with Blooms take 20% more healing from you
tip
Wildstalker's Power raises Rejuvenation, Efflorescence and Lifebloom healing by 10%. Cat Form damage is optional. Wowhead considers caster damage (Moonfire / Wrath) ahead in AoE since 12.0.5
disp
Lethal Preservation: each time you remove an effect with Nature's Cure or Soothe, heal 4% of your max health (an injured party member if you are full)
tip
Wowhead's recommended (Best) hero talent for Mythic+. Icy Veins also recommends Wildstalker for its healing output
tip
Every Swiftmend or Wild Growth makes Grove Guardians summon a Treant that heals for 8 sec. With Dream Surge, 3 allies around the target (4 with Power of the Dream) are healed instantly on summon
aoe

Harmony of the Grove: 5% more healing per active Treant; Power of Nature raises Rejuvenation, Efflorescence and Lifebloom by 10%. Chain Swiftmend and Wild Growth right before big AoE damage to stack Treants
tb
Spirit of the Thicket: Ironbark summons a Dryad that channels a 6 sec healing beam on the target. Ironbark on a tank buster brings healing with it
tip

Sylvan Beckoning: periodic healing about once a minute empowers your next Swiftmend, and a Dryad casts a 10%-strength Tranquility and Regrowth. With Dryad's Dance, Swiftmend recharges 25% faster while the Dryad is out
tip
Wowhead sees little difference between hero choices in Mythic+, but gives the recommendation (Best) only to Wildstalker
aoe
Tranquility · 3 min · 6 sec channel, heals all allies within 40 yards. During the channel, roots absorb damage up to 60% of your health and prevent knockbacks
aoe
Convoke the Spirits · 2 min, 1 min with Cenarius' Guidance · casts 12 random druid spells over 3 sec. Healing-focused when not shapeshifted, damage-focused in Cat Form (Wowhead)
aoe
Nature's Swiftness · 1 min · your next Regrowth is instant, free and heals 60% more. With Overgrowth it also applies Lifebloom, Rejuvenation and Wild Growth effects
aoe
Wild Growth · 10 sec · heals 5 injured allies within 30 yards of the target over 7 sec. Use for moderate damage and right before AoE damage
tb
Ironbark · 1 min 30 sec, 1 min 10 sec with Improved Ironbark · 20% damage taken reduction for 12 sec, 16 sec with Regenerative Heartwood. The target receives an extra 75% of your Rejuvenation healing
tb
Barkskin · 1 min · 20% damage taken reduction, 10% more with Oakskin. 12 sec with Improved Barkskin. Usable while stunned or feared, and adds a Matted Fur absorb shield
tb
Frenzied Regeneration · 36 sec · heals 24% health over 3 sec in Bear Form. Auto-triggers below 40% health once every 2 min with Well-Honed Instincts
tip
Swiftmend · 15 sec, 2 charges with Prosperity · with Everbloom it makes Lifebloom bloom 3 times in a row, and Soul of the Forest empowers your next Regrowth / Rejuvenation
tip
Stampeding Roar · 2 min · 60% movement speed for party members within 15 yards for 8 sec. For escaping pools and long moves
disp
Nature's Cure (8 sec) removes magic, and Improved Nature's Cure, taken in both Mythic+ builds, also removes curses and poisons. It cannot remove diseases
disp
Soothe (10 sec) removes enrage effects from enemies
int
Restoration Druid has no interrupt. Stop AoE casts with Incapacitating Roar (30 sec, Bear Form, 10-yard 3 sec incapacitate) and Typhoon (30 sec, 15-yard frontal knockback). They do not work on bosses
pos

Ursol's Vortex (1 min) slows enemies within 8 yards by 50% and pulls back those trying to leave once. Combined with Typhoon it groups scattered mobs (Icy Veins). Wildstalker's Entangling Vortex roots pulled enemies for 3 sec
tip
Battle res is Rebirth (10 min). Use Nature's Swiftness first to make it instant. Shapeshifting clears your own movement-impairing effects
disp

Devour week: the rift debuff is removed by dispels and healing. Dispel with Nature's Cure starting with party members who can't clear it themselves and those without Lifebloom; clear your own by shapeshifting too (Icy Veins)
int
Ascendant week: stop the casts of all 10 orbs at once with Incapacitating Roar or Typhoon (Icy Veins)
pos
Pulsar week: use Stampeding Roar or Wild Charge to reach the orbs
tip
Xal'atath's Guile at +12 and above: 15 sec lost per death

Rav'i: [광역 피해] Top the party with Wild Growth before Ravenous Stomp (145474 Nature to everyone), and spread Rejuvenation on 5+ players before Ssscavenging to keep Abundance active. Use Tranquility if the shield holds for long
[탱버] Hydrastrike's three hits are Physical damage. Ironbark the tank before the cast and keep Lifebloom on them
[해제] Nature's Cure cannot remove the Regurgitate disease, so leave it to a player who can dispel diseases
The Writhing Coil: [해제] Remove the Spiteful Venom poison stacking on the Spiteful Hunt target with Nature's Cure
[광역 피해] During the 35 sec Synchronized Venom DoT, keep Lifebloom and Efflorescence up and use Wild Growth on cooldown
[광역 피해] If Death Rattle party damage grows, use Convoke the Spirits while not shapeshifted
Zul'jan: [광역 피해] Alternate Tranquility and Convoke the Spirits for each 8 sec Ritual of the Fang channel. If you used Tranquility on the last pull, cover the first Ritual with Convoke the Spirits
[참고] Pre-place Rejuvenation on players who deliberately take Boneslicer or a slowed Axegrinder axe to clear Ritual Venom, and Swiftmend them right after the hit
[탱버] Use Ironbark if the tank is low during Chop Down's two hits (484912 Physical each)

Lightblossom Trinity: [탱버] Bedrock Slam (484912 Physical + 193965 Nature) comes soon after the Lightblossom Beam soak ends. Keep Lifebloom on the tank while they block the beam inside Fertile Loam, and Ironbark them as the soak ends
[광역 피해] Cast Wild Growth before the 8 sec Lightbloom Overgrowth AoE, and use Swiftmend to empower Rejuvenation with Soul of the Forest so it spreads to 3 players
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: [해제] Bloodthorn Roots is a magic effect per its tooltip. If the Bloodthirsty Gaze target is rooted, free them first with Nature's Cure
[광역 피해] Spread Rejuvenation 6 sec before Thorncaller Roar and use Wild Growth as the cast starts
[광역 피해] Save both Tranquility and Convoke the Spirits for Lightcrazed Frenzy after 50% and split them
Lightwarden Ruia: [탱버] In Moonkin Form, Warden's Wrath (Nature, magic damage) repeatedly hits the tank; in Bear Form, Mangling Claws doubles melee damage. In both forms keep Lifebloom and two Rejuvenations (Germination) on the tank, and Ironbark them as Bear Form begins

[참고] The Grievous Thrash bleed only ends at 100% health. Before the cones, top up Pulverizing Strikes targets (healers and DPS) that still bleed first, using Swiftmend and a Nature's Swiftness Regrowth
[광역 피해] Use Tranquility for the 40% Spirits of the Vale phase, but get into position first so Lightfire Beams' silence does not cut the channel
Ziekket: [위치] Lifetreading places Efflorescence under your Lifebloom target, so if the tank moves far away, move Lifebloom to a ranged player standing with the group so it heals Oozing Xylem damage
[탱버] Ironbark the tank for Thornspike (193965 Holy, then 58189 Physical bleed per sec for 10 sec), and Swiftmend the tank after the knockback carries them away

[참고] Once Lashers spawn, Lightspore Shot mostly targets the tank standing in the middle of the adds, and the tank also soaks about 3 orbs, so put Rejuvenation on the tank and on players who soaked orbs to cover the 12 sec Holy DoT

The Hoardmonger: [해제] Remove Toxic Spores poison stacks with Nature's Cure, highest stacks first. With an 8 sec cooldown it is one player at a time
[광역 피해] Spread Rejuvenation before Ravenous Bellow and use Wild Growth as the cast starts
[광역 피해] Use Tranquility for the Hearty Bellow after it eats the meat. You cannot be knocked back while channeling
Sentinel of Winter: [해제] Remove the Glacial Torment magic DoT with Nature's Cure
[광역 피해] During Frozen Tempest, hold out inside Snowdrift with Wild Growth and Convoke the Spirits
[회피] If you are too slow to dodge Raging Squall, Wild Charge to a party member
Nalorakk: [광역 피해] Spread Rejuvenation before Overwhelming Onslaught's three hits, and lift the group with Wild Growth and Swiftmend right after the knockback
[광역 피해] Use Tranquility or Convoke the Spirits for Fury of the War God, and put Rejuvenation on the three Echoing Maul targets before their Echoes land

[탱버] Overwhelming Onslaught's three hits (armor-ignoring Physical) are the tank's big damage. Ironbark (16 sec) the tank on the first hit so it also covers the Forceful Slam soak right after the knockback

Kystia Manaheart: [해제] Clear the Corroding Spittle Magic DoT with Nature's Cure, starting with players facing Mirror Images clones. If there are not enough kicks for the five clones' Felstorm, stop them together with Incapacitating Roar or Typhoon
[광역 피해] With Concealed Pistol, Destabilized ends in two windows (Topicx). Use Tranquility on the first Destabilized and Convoke the Spirits on the second, with Wild Growth in between
[탱버] Chaos Barrage (Chaos magic damage) hits the tank all fight, so keep Lifebloom on them and Ironbark the tank if back-to-back hits drop their health
Zaen Bladesorrow: [탱버] The worker pack dragged in at the start hits hard and endangers the tank. Ironbark the tank as the fight starts, and use it on Envenom (big Physical damage) once it returns after 1 min 10 sec
[해제] Clear Heartstop Poison (30% less max health) on the tank at once with Nature's Cure
[광역 피해] Line Convoke the Spirits up with the second Bloodlust, and use Tranquility when Killing Spree, which Topicx names as a raid defensive spot, overlaps with the Fel-Infused Freight DoT
Xathuux the Annihilator: [탱버] Legion Strike reduces healing taken by 80% for 8 sec, so Ironbark the tank before the cast and keep Lifebloom on them. If Ironbark is back when Demonic Rage raises the boss's attack speed by 75% for 15 sec, use it then
[광역 피해] Spread Rejuvenation before Infernal Crush, and use Tranquility if an Axe Toss axe is still alive

[광역 피해] The third Bloodlust goes on the second Demonic Rage, so line Convoke the Spirits up with it, and if you must circle wide around Burning Steps, raise the party's movement speed with Stampeding Roar
Lithiel Cinderfury: [광역 피해] Cover constant Searing Fel Flame damage with Lifebloom and Efflorescence and use Wild Growth on cooldown
[차단] Stop Felfire Burst from Wild Imps grouped by Fingers of Gul'dan all at once with Incapacitating Roar
[참고] Top off party members hit by Malefic Wave first with Swiftmend and Regrowth

Taz'Rah: [광역 피해] Spread Rejuvenation before Dark Bloom and line Tranquility or Convoke the Spirits up with it
[위치] When the tank drags Ethereal Shades to the outer wall and circles along it, move Lifebloom to a ranged player with the group so Efflorescence grows under the party
[탱버] Void Blast (271551 Shadow plus knockback) is a magic tank hit that needs a defensive every time. Ironbark the tank on any Void Blast their own defensives do not cover
Atroxus: [광역 피해] While Toxic Creeper is alive, use Convoke the Spirits and Wild Growth for Toxic Aura damage and save Tranquility for Monstrous Roar
[탱버] Time Ironbark with Hulking Claw nature damage, and top off right away with a Nature's Swiftness Regrowth if Sickening Bite stacks are high
[해제] Mind-Numbing Poison from Poison Splash and Poison Pool is a poison effect. Remove it with Nature's Cure from party members slowed by the 30% Haste reduction
Charonus: [광역 피해] Put Rejuvenation on players spread by Cosmic Crash and use Wild Growth on cooldown during the 20 sec DoT

[광역 피해] Gravitic Orbs target DPS, not the tank, and they take heavy Condensed Mass damage while dragging orbs through the pools (Topicx). Use Tranquility or Convoke the Spirits in this phase and follow the targets with Swiftmend
[탱버] Ironbark the tank for Dark Waves (5 sec cast, 339438 Shadow). Cosmic Crash needs no tank defensive, so save Ironbark

The Golden Serpent: [광역 피해] Use Tranquility for Serpentine Gust. You are not knocked back while channeling
[위치] Hold Animated Gold packs with Ursol's Vortex so they can't reach the boss. Wildstalker roots them for 3 sec with Entangling Vortex
[참고] Put Rejuvenation on the Spit Gold target and Swiftmend if the DoT hits hard
Mchimba the Embalmer: [광역 피해] Spread Rejuvenation before Awakening Slam and use Wild Growth right after the AoE damage
[참고] Desiccation on the Drain Fluids target only clears above 90% health, so push it up in one go with Swiftmend and a Nature's Swiftness Regrowth
[차단] The Wretched Discharge disease cannot be dispelled, so if a mummy kick is missed, stop it with Incapacitating Roar or Typhoon
The Council of Tribes: [해제] If Zanazal's Poison Nova kick is missed, remove the 12 sec poison DoT with Nature's Cure, lowest-health party members first

[탱버] Cast Ironbark (16 sec) on the tank with Aka'ali's Debilitating Backhand (727368 Physical) so it also covers the 10 sec Shattered Defenses that follows. Save Ironbark on a Backhand the tank kites instead of using a defensive

[광역 피해] From the moment Zanazal is engaged, Arc Lightning (135775 Nature) hits the tank and arcs to nearby players, so use Wild Growth on cooldown. In the Kula phase, Swiftmend the Severing Axe target
Dazar, The First King: [광역 피해] Use Tranquility for Gilded Destruction and follow up during the 15 sec DoT with Wild Growth and Convoke the Spirits

[탱버] Save Ironbark in phase 1 (Reban), and after 80% use it on the tank when Blade Combo follows right after T'zala's Savage Maul bleed. The Savage Maul bleed cannot be dispelled, so support with two Rejuvenations (Germination) and Swiftmend

Melidrussa Chillworn: [참고] The tank kicks Frigid Shard (Physical) right after Hailburst ice lands. If the tank misses it, Swiftmend the tank
[광역 피해] Use Convoke the Spirits for the intermission Frost Overload and Wild Growth for the Chillstorm explosion

[해제] Infused Whelp's Cold Claws is a magic effect that turns into Frozen Solid at 20 stacks. Use Nature's Cure (8 sec) on the tank on cooldown, and if there are too many whelps for the dispel to keep up, Ironbark the tank
Kokia Blazehoof: [탱버] Use Ironbark on the tank for the 4-hit Searing Blows and keep Lifebloom and Rejuvenation up
[광역 피해] Leave Blaze Volley kicks to the party, and use Tranquility as Inferno stacks build
Kyrakka & Erkhart Stormvein: [참고] Right before Interrupting Cloudburst ends, use instants like Rejuvenation, Swiftmend and Lifebloom instead of Regrowth and Tranquility

[해제] The Stormslam debuff (381515) is a magic effect: remove it with Nature's Cure before the next Stormslam. The tank takes Stormslam with baseline mitigation, so use Ironbark on an Inferno Spit target as their circle explodes
[광역 피해] Stack Tranquility and Convoke the Spirits at the start of phase 2

Adderis & Aspix: [광역 피해] Put your Lifebloom target at the melee spot where the party stacks to share Thunder and Lightning so Efflorescence lands there, then use Wild Growth right after
[광역 피해] Use Convoke the Spirits when Aspix's ability cycle speeds up after Adderis dies
Merektha: [해제] Remove the 8 sec Toxic Viper Poison Spit poison with Nature's Cure
[광역 피해] Use Tranquility for Serpentstorm. While channeling you won't be pushed into pools
[탱버] Keep Lifebloom on the tank through each Lightning Bite and use Ironbark if they are low
Galvazzt: [참고] Don't move Lifebloom to beam soakers; support them with 2 Rejuvenations (Germination) and Swiftmend
[참고] Nothing targets the tank and the tank does not soak beams, so use Ironbark on a beam soaker with high Galvanized stacks
[광역 피해] Have Wild Growth ready before Induction AoE damage
Avatar of Sethraliss: [참고] During the 30 sec of phase 2, put Lifebloom and Rejuvenation on the Avatar and top it off with Swiftmend and a Nature's Swiftness Regrowth
[위치] Hold the Faithless Tormentor chasing the healer with Ursol's Vortex and push it with Typhoon so it takes the AoE

145205.d: 대상 위치에 치유의 꽃을 피워, 10미터 내의 부상당한 아군 3명을 30초 동안 2초마다 (주문력의 58.56%)씩 치유합니다. 한 번에 하나의 꽃만 피울 수 있습니다.

155675.d: 같은 대상에게 회복을 2번 중첩할 수 있습니다.

158478.d: 신속한 치유가 다음 재생 또는 회복의 치유량을 60%만큼 증가시킵니다. [대드루이드의 힘: 또한 20미터 내의 추가 대상 2명에게 부여됩니다]

203651.d: 자연의 신속함이 다음 재생 시전 시 아군 한 명에게 피어나는 생명, 회복, 급속 성장 효과를 부여하게 합니다.

207383.d: 활성화된 회복이 5개 이상이면 재생의 자원 소모량이 60%만큼 감소하고 치명타 및 극대화율이 60%만큼 증가합니다.

213764.m: 특성 · 8 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 표범 변신, 곰 변신 필요
213764.d: 주위 적들을 휘둘러 공격하여 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 변신 형태에 따라 공격력이 달라집니다.

274902.d: 피어나는 생명이 부여된 대상에게 주기적인 치유 효과가 발동할 때 8%의 확률로 피어나는 생명의 치유 효과가 발동합니다.

377847.d: 생명력이 40% 미만으로 떨어지면 광포한 재생력을 시전합니다. 120초에 한 번씩만 발동합니다.

385786.d: 나무 껍질 또는 생존 본능 사용 시 15초 동안 [1875 / 100 * 전투력 * (1 + 유연성)]의 피해를 흡수합니다.

391528.m: 특성 · 집중 (4 초 주문 시전 시간) · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
391528.d:
영혼을 불러내 마력을 폭발시켜 4초에 걸쳐 16 / 우르속의 인도: 12 / 엘룬의 인도: 12 / 천공의 통찰력: 20회의 드루이드 주문 및 능력을 질풍처럼 시전합니다. [아샤메인의 인도: 뛰어난 주문이나 능력을 사용할 확률이 증가합니다]

현재 변신 상태에 따라 주위의 적절한 대상에게 급속 성장, 신속한 치유, 달빛섬광, 천벌, 재생, 회복, 갈퀴 발톱, 난타를 시전합니다.

392116.d: 자신의 무쇠껍질로 보호된 아군이 자신의 활성화된 각각의 회복 주문 치유량의 75%만큼 함께 치유됩니다. 또한 무쇠껍질의 지속시간이 4초만큼 증가합니다.

392302.d: 숲의 영혼 시전 시 다음 회복 또는 재생이 대상으로부터 20미터 안에 있는 2명의 아군에게 추가로 적용됩니다.

392325.d: 피어나는 생명이 만개하면 자신의 꽃피우기의 범위 내에 있는 최대 3명의 대상을 (주문력의 133%)만큼 치유합니다.

392378.d: 자연의 치유력이 추가로 모든 저주 및 독 효과를 제거합니다.

393371.d:
화신: 생명의 나무
화신: 생명의 나무의 지속시간 동안 10초마다 숲 수호자를 소환합니다. 화신: 생명의 나무의 재사용 대기시간은 숲 수호자가 사라질 때마다 5.0초만큼 감소합니다.

영혼 소집
영혼 소집의 재사용 대기시간이 50%만큼, 지속시간과 시전하는 주문의 수가 25%만큼 감소합니다. 영혼 소집 시전 시 뛰어난 주문이나 능력을 사용할 확률이 증가합니다.

404521.d: 재생의 지속 치유 효과가 100%만큼 증가하며, 피어나는 생명의 대상에게도 적용됩니다.

428544.d: 숲 수호자가 6초마다 한 번씩 주위의 대상에게 달빛섬광을 시전합니다.

428731.d: 숲 수호자가 활성화된 동안 각 숲 수호자 하나당 치유량이 5%만큼 증가합니다.

428859.d: 숲 수호자가 활성화되어 있는 동안 자신의 회복, 꽃피우기, 피어나는 생명의 치유량이 10%만큼 증가합니다.

433831.d: 숲 수호자 소환 시 대상에게 꿈의 꽃잎을 자라나게 하여 최대 3명의 주위 아군을 (주문력의 146.4%)만큼 치유합니다.

439528.d:
도려내기 및 갈퀴 발톱으로 피해를 주면 일정 확률로 대상에게 피바라미 덩굴이 자라나 6초에 걸쳐 (전투력의 97.5%)의 출혈 피해를 입힙니다.

급속 성장 및 재생, 꽃피우기로 생명력을 회복시키면 일정 확률로 대상에게 공생체 꽃이 자라나 6초에 걸쳐 (주문력의 219.6%)의 생명력을 회복시킵니다.

이 효과는 중첩 가능합니다.

439895.d: 우르솔의 회오리로 끌어당겨진 적이 3초 동안 이동 불가 상태가 됩니다. 대상이 피해를 받으면 효과가 취소될 수 있습니다.

439926.d:
도려내기 및 흉포한 이빨의 공격력이 5%만큼 증가합니다.

회복, 꽃피우기 및 피어나는 생명의 치유량이 10%만큼 증가합니다.

440118.d: 신속한 치유 또는 급속 성장 시전 시 대상에게 6초 동안 공생체 꽃을 자라나게 만듭니다.

440119.d:
피바라미 덩굴의 영향을 받는 적은 시전자의 능력으로 받는 피해가 4%만큼 증가합니다.

공생체 꽃의 영향을 받는 대상은 시전자의 주문으로 받는 치유 효과가 20%만큼 증가합니다.

440120.d:
피바라미 덩굴이 만료되거나 대상에게 흉포한 이빨을 사용하면 가시 폭발을 일으켜 주위의 적에게 (전투력의 100%)의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 5명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

공생체 꽃이 만료되거나 대상에게 회복을 시전하면 대상 주위로 꽃이 자라나 대상과 최대 3명의 주위 아군을 (주문력의 42.09%)만큼 치유합니다.

449191.d: 생존 본능과 나무 껍질이 받는 피해를 추가로 10%만큼 감소시킵니다.

455461.d: 달래기 또는 [자연의 치유력 / 해제]으로 효과를 제거하면 연계 점수 1점을 생성하고 최대 생명력의 4%를 회복합니다. 생명력이 최대일 경우 부상당한 파티원 또는 공격대원을 치유합니다.

474750.m: 특성 · 2% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 1.5 초 주문 시전 시간
474750.d: 아군과 유대를 형성합니다. 자신을 치유하면 유대를 맺은 아군을 치유량의 10%만큼 회복시킵니다. 또한 유대를 맺은 아군을 치유하면 치유량의 8%만큼 자신의 생명력을 회복합니다.

1217941.d: 꽃피우기의 치유량이 25%만큼 증가하고, 자동으로 피어나는 생명 대상의 발밑에 자라납니다.

1244470.d: 신속한 치유 시전 시 피어나는 생명이 만발하는 광란의 폭발을 일으켜 빠르게 3번 치유 효과를 발휘하게 합니다.

1261867.m: 특성 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
1261867.d: 현재 활성화된 변신 형상에 따라 강력한 비역할 능력을 사용합니다.

1264614.m: 특성 · 매 분마다 약 1번 효과 발동됨
1264614.d: 주기적인 치유 효과가 일정 확률로 다음 신속한 치유를 강화하여 드리아드를 소환해 전투를 돕게 만듭니다. 드리아드는 10%의 효율로 평온을 시전하고, 재생을 시전해 생명력이 가장 낮은 아군을 (주문력의 658.507%)만큼 치유합니다.

1264776.d: 드리아드가 신속한 치유의 재사용 대기시간 회복 속도를 25%만큼 증가시킵니다.

1264899.d: 무쇠껍질 사용 시 드리아드를 소환해 대상에게 순수한 자연의 광선을 집중하여 6초에 걸쳐 (주문력의 4392%)의 생명력을 회복시킵니다.

1: [광역 피해] This is the first big pull with Bloodlust, so line Convoke the Spirits (1 min with Cenarius' Guidance) up with Bloodlust, and pre-cast Wild Growth before Sporeblight Belcher starts Spouting Floret (87284 Holy to the whole party every 2 sec for 6 sec).

[제어] When Radiant Spellsower gets low, drop Ursol's Vortex (1 min, 50% slow within 8 yards, pulls an enemy back to the center the first time it tries to leave) under it so Call The Grove cannot carry it to a sleeping Lasher pack.
2: [차단] If the two Radiant Spellsowers' Light Bolt Volley (4 sec cast, 174568 Holy to the whole party) is not kicked, step within 10 yards and stop both with Incapacitating Roar (30 sec, shifts you into Bear Form).
3: [탱버] If the Ironbark (1 min 10 sec with Improved Ironbark) you used on pull 1 is not back before Virid Grovekeeper's Earthrupture Strike, refill the tank right after the hit with Swiftmend (2 charges with Prosperity) and a Nature's Swiftness Regrowth.
[제어] Two Radiant Spellsowers stand next to 12 Lashers, so if Ursol's Vortex (1 min) is back, drop it under the Spellsowers to stop a Call The Grove escape.
[참고] Put Rejuvenation on anyone hit by Underbrush Stalker's Thornblade (96982 Nature, then 77586 Physical bleed every 2 sec for 12 sec) and keep it up until the bleed ends.
5: [광역 피해] Handle Spouting Floret from the first-pulled Sporeblight Belcher with Wild Growth, and keep Ironbark for Earthrupture Strike from the Virid Grovekeeper pulled 5-6 sec later. Save Tranquility (3 min) for Lightcrazed Frenzy below 50% on the next boss, Ikuzz.

[차단] If Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech (4 sec cast, 3 sec disorient) is not kicked, stop it with Typhoon (30 sec, 15-yard frontal knockback) or Incapacitating Roar. You cannot heal during the 3 sec disorient.
7: [탱버] When two Luminous Thornmaws chain Grievous Gash (387930 Physical plus a stacking bleed), Ironbark the first Gash and top the tank to 100% before the second to clear the bleed. The bleed only ends at full health, so spend both Swiftmend charges on the tank.
[차단] If Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech is not kicked, stop it with Typhoon or Incapacitating Roar.
8: [광역 피해] Handle Spouting Floret with Wild Growth and Convoke the Spirits and do not use Tranquility here. You need Tranquility for the 40% Spirits of the Vale phase on the next boss, Lightwarden Ruia.
10: [해제] Toxic Spew (58189 Nature every 1.5 sec for 9 sec) poisons the whole party, but Nature's Cure only clears one player every 8 sec. Dispel the lowest player first and carry the rest with Wild Growth.
[탱버] Tongue Toss (2 sec cast, 290947 Physical) throws the tank far away, so check the tank's Lifebloom during the cast and Swiftmend right after the landing.
11: [탱버] Ironbark Luminous Thornmaw's Grievous Gash and cover Spouting Floret with Wild Growth. Even while Floret ticks, Swiftmend the tank to 100% first to clear the Gash bleed.
[차단] When three Lightfeather Petalwings cast Disorienting Screech together there are not enough kicks, so Incapacitating Roar the stacked Petalwings to stop them at once.
12: [광역 피해] If Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret overlaps with Light Bolt Volley from two Radiant Spellsowers, use Tranquility. If the Tranquility from Lightwarden Ruia's 40% phase is not back yet, use Convoke the Spirits instead.

[차단] Lightgorged Lashers (6 in this pull) are immune to crowd control while their Lightbloom Pollination shield holds, so spend Incapacitating Roar and Typhoon on Radiant Spellsower's Light Bolt Volley.
[탱버] While a Pollination shield holds, nearby enemies gain 50% attack speed, so Ironbark the tank and keep Lifebloom and Rejuvenation on them until the shields break.

1: [탱버] Ravenous Descendants (7 of them) gain stacking attack speed the longer they live, and one missed Piercing Hiss from a Primal Serpent cuts the tank's haste by 30% for 6 sec. When you see either, use Ironbark (1 min 10 sec with Improved Ironbark, 16 sec with Regenerative Heartwood) on the tank.

[해제] Twinfang Harrower's Paralyzing Shots (48491 Nature every 1 sec for 20 sec, 10% slow per tick) is a Magic effect, but Nature's Cure clears only one player every 8 sec. Clear melee players first since they must dodge Toxic Breath and Septic Spatter pools, and cover the rest with Rejuvenation.
2: [광역 피해] Topicx calls this a cooldown pull. Before Blood Sacrifice (87284 Physical to the whole party, then a 162029 heal absorb), spread Rejuvenation on 5+ players so the HoTs chew through the absorb first, and use Convoke the Spirits (1 min with Cenarius' Guidance) right after Blood Sacrifice.
[탱버] When Ritual Chieftain casts Dismember (3 sec cast, 581895 Physical), Ironbark the tank. If Ironbark is on cooldown, Swiftmend (2 charges with Prosperity) the tank right after the hit.
3: [위치] This pull uses a pillar line of sight so the three Primal Serpents walk in. Put Lifebloom on the tank before the mobs arrive so Lifetreading grows Efflorescence behind the pillar where the tank stops.
[탱버] With three Serpents, a single Piercing Hiss that lands cuts the tank's haste by 30%. Use Ironbark then if it is back; if not, refill the tank at once with a Nature's Swiftness Regrowth.
4: [광역 피해] If the Convoke the Spirits from pull 2 is back after 1 min, use it again on this pull's Blood Sacrifice; if not, chew through the heal absorb with Wild Growth and Swiftmend.
5: [광역 피해] Paralyzing Shots DoTs from two Twinfang Harrowers overlap with Ritual Chieftain's Blood Sacrifice absorb, and Topicx says this is hard to heal through on high keys. Use Convoke the Spirits right after Blood Sacrifice, and if the party keeps dropping, use Tranquility (3 min). If you do not use Tranquility here, save it for Ssscavenging on the next boss, Rav'i.
[해제] Paralyzing Shots comes from two Harrowers, so Nature's Cure (8 sec) cannot keep up. Clear the player with the most slow stacks first.
7: [해제] Before Rattling Writhe casts Rattle (3 sec cast, 58189 armor-ignoring Physical every 1 sec for 5 sec), clear the Envenom poison with Nature's Cure first. If Nature's Cure is on cooldown, cast Wild Growth as Rattle starts.

[탱버] Corrosive Fangs (3 sec cast, 242456 Nature, then 20% more damage taken for 20 sec) is Nature damage, so armor does not reduce it. When you see the cast, Ironbark (16 sec) the tank to cover the damage-taken window.
8: [탱버] If the Ironbark (1 min 10 sec) from pull 7 is not back, spend both Swiftmend charges and a Nature's Swiftness Regrowth on the tank hit by Corrosive Fangs to carry them through the 20 sec damage-taken increase.
9: [해제] When the two High Evolutionists land Envenom on two players, Nature's Cure (8 sec) clears only one. Clear the lower player before the next Rattle and give the other two Rejuvenations (Germination) to survive Rattle.
[차단] If an Evolve channel (6 sec, ends with a shield and crowd control immunity) is not stunned, step within 10 yards and stop it with Incapacitating Roar (30 sec, 3 sec incapacitate).
11: [광역 피해] Mass Envenom has no dispel type, so Nature's Cure cannot remove it. If any of the four finishes the cast, heal through the 8 sec DoT with Wild Growth and Swiftmend, and save Nature's Cure for Envenom poison.
[차단] Four High Evolutionists outnumber the kicks, so when stacked Evolutionists cast Mass Envenom or Evolve, stop them together with Incapacitating Roar.
12: [탱버] Ascendant Serpent's Noxious Spray (3 sec cast, 67888 Nature every 1 sec for 5 sec) keeps hitting while it pushes the tank back, so Ironbark the tank on the cast.

[광역 피해] When the party stacks on the tank's ping for Infest (34914 Nature every 1 sec for 5 sec, then 69827 Nature within 8 yards), the tank's Lifebloom puts Efflorescence on that spot. Cast Wild Growth as soon as Infest lands to top everyone before the bursts.
13: [광역 피해] Ula'tek's Chosen's Toxic Surge (29095 Nature to the whole party every 1 sec for 9 sec) overlaps with dodging Toxic Beam (339438 Nature). Channels break when you move, so cover Surge with pre-placed Rejuvenation and Wild Growth, and cast Convoke the Spirits from a spot clear of Toxic Beam.

[참고] When the six Living Venoms die together, Venom Burst party damage stacks up; Topicx's group nearly wiped here. If several melt at once, cast Wild Growth immediately and Swiftmend the lowest player.
14: [광역 피해] Topicx says to use party defensives on this pull's Toxic Surge. If the Convoke the Spirits (1 min) from pull 13 is back, use it after dodging Toxic Beam, and save Tranquility for the Blood Sacrifice and Toxic Surge overlap on pull 16.
15: [해제] Twinfang Harrower's Paralyzing Shots is a Magic effect. If it lands on a player that Blade of the Altar also hit with Laced Edge (teleport behind them and apply a Nature DoT), clear that player's Paralyzing Shots first with Nature's Cure.
16: [광역 피해] Two Ritual Chieftains chain Blood Sacrifice and Ula'tek's Chosen adds Toxic Surge, which Topicx calls the heaviest healing pull. Use the Tranquility you saved when the first Toxic Surge overlaps with Blood Sacrifice, from a spot clear of Toxic Beam, and cover the first Ritual of the Fang on the next boss, Zul'jan, with Convoke the Spirits.
[탱버] Dismember comes from two Chieftains, but Ironbark (1 min 10 sec) covers only one. Ironbark the first Dismember, and for the second keep Lifebloom on the tank and Swiftmend right after the hit.

1: [광역 피해] Topicx uses Bloodlust here and pulls Bribed Captain together with Bribed Guard. Line Convoke the Spirits (1 min with Cenarius' Guidance) up with Bloodlust, and keep Rejuvenation spread wide while the Captain's Deep Corruption aura is up.

[탱버] Bribed Guard's Shield Bash raises Physical damage taken by 20% for 20 sec and overlaps with the Captain's tank hits, so Ironbark (1 min 10 sec with Improved Ironbark, 16 sec) the tank on the first Shield Bash.

[해제] Street Sneak's Heartstop Poison lowers max health by 5% per stack and puts the tank most at risk. Use Nature's Cure (8 sec) on the tank first, and cover players with the Cutpurse bleed (not dispellable) with Rejuvenation.
2: [해제] Seductive Sayaad's Seduction (6 sec disorient) is a Magic effect, so Nature's Cure removes it. If a kick is missed and someone is seduced, clear them at once with Nature's Cure.
3: [탱버] Keep Lifebloom on the tank while Bribed Guard's Shield Bash (20% more Physical damage taken for 20 sec) is up, and if the Ironbark from pull 1 is back, use it on the second Shield Bash.
4: [해제] Heartstop Poison from four Street Sneaks stacks fast, so use Nature's Cure on the tank each time it is ready to clear all stacks. If the tank's max health shrinks in between, use Ironbark.
